newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Collapsed building buries workers in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Collapsed building buries workers in Pakistan.

text.p: At least 45 Pakistani labourers were buried on Wednesday when a four-storey building they were constructing collapsed in Karachi, ambulance volunteers said.
They said the labourers were having lunch on the second floor of an apartment block known as Faiza Heights in the New Karachi district when the structure collapsed.
Police, ambulance volunteers and local residents were digging through the rubble in search of survivors.

"The number of casualties is still unclear as no one has been dug out of the debris," one ambulance volunteer said, adding that 45 labourers were believed to have been in the half-finished building at the time.
"The whole building has caved in and the top floor of the building is now what we can see." No further details were immediately available.
